name: MoYu PB WR 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated)
description: The MoYu PB WR 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) is the same-edition cube Wang Yiheng used to set the 3x3 average world record at 3.51 seconds. It pairs a lightweight carbon fiber core with a 100-magnet configuration and one-button triple adjustment, so you can dial in a champion's feel and then keep tuning until it's yours.
features: Lightweight and fast: An upgraded carbon fiber core keeps the cube light at roughly 72g while holding up to explosive, high-speed solving.
8-level MagLev elasticity: Magnetic springs deliver low-resistance, quiet turning with a light, consistent return.
8-level precision tension: Fine digital tension steps let you control tightness and looseness in small increments.
8-level edge & corner magnetic force: Adjust magnetic spacing across multiple levels to match your turning style.
Wang Yiheng's WR setup: Out of the box it ships at his world-record tuning — Tension 1, Elasticity 1, Magnetic Strength 8 — as a proven starting point.
20-Magnet Ball-Core: Ball-Core Positioning 3.0 flagship configuration with a full 100-magnet count for auto-alignment and stability through the whole turn.
